# Nonprofit Association of Washington

> NAWA is Washington State's membership organization supporting nonprofits, businesses, and government agencies through advocacy, learning resources, partnerships, and professional development.

The Nonprofit Association of Washington (NAWA) serves as the primary network for nonprofit organizations across Washington State, offering membership benefits, capacity-building resources, conferences, and vendor partnerships. The organization connects nonprofits with training, discounts, directories, and collaborative opportunities to strengthen the sector.

## Key Topics

- Nonprofit Association of Washington (NAWA)
- Washington State nonprofits
- Membership options
- Nonprofit capacity building

## Membership & Joining

- [Join NAWA](https://nonprofitwa.org/membership/join-nawa): Membership join page with pricing tiers for nonprofits, businesses, government, and individuals
- [Member Discount Programs](https://nonprofitwa.org/membership/member-discount-programs): Member discount programs and vendor partnerships including GrantsMagic U
- [Impact Partners](https://nonprofitwa.org/membership/membership-partners): Partnership organizations providing member benefits and capacity building
- [Member Directories](https://nonprofitwa.org/membership/member-directories): Member directories searchable by nonprofit, business, and philanthropic organizations

## Learning & Professional Development

- [Learning Library](https://nonprofitwa.org/learn/learning-library): Training resources on nonprofit fundamentals, boards, finance, legal, and advocacy
- [Conferences](https://nonprofitwa.org/learn/conferences): Nonprofit conferences and events including Washington State Nonprofit Conference

## About NAWA

- [Strategy](https://nonprofitwa.org/about-us/strategy): Organizational strategy, mission, and strategic plan for NAWA
- [Meet Our Team](https://nonprofitwa.org/about-us/staff): Staff directory and team bios for Nonprofit Association of Washington leadership
- [Board of Directors](https://nonprofitwa.org/about-us/board): Board of Directors profiles and governance structure for NAWA
- [Get Connected](https://nonprofitwa.org/about-us/contact): Contact information and social media links for NAWA community engagement
